# Kuchup payment go-live

## What already exists

The [Application Credit Wallet](file:///Users/amin/.cursor/plans/application_credit_wallet_621d3b6a.plan.md) checkout is **coded**, not live:

- Packs 50/$4.99, 150/$11.99, 400/$24.99 in [`relocation_jobs/credits/policy.py`](relocation_jobs/credits/policy.py)
- NOWPayments invoice + IPN in [`relocation_jobs/payments/`](relocation_jobs/payments/)
- Panel wallet dialog, admin reconcile/revoke, tests for grant-once / bad signature

The older [Google-auth Phase F](file:///Users/amin/.cursor/plans/google-only_auth_3870d8ae.plan.md) is still **pending**: pricing still says Full Access “Coming soon”; IPN never sets `plan=full`.

## Billing decision (locked this round)

**Full Access = $29 one-time, lifetime `plan=full`.** No monthly billing.

Job search is a bounded campaign, not a subscription habit. NOWPayments invoices are one-shot; recurring would fight the provider (and the original “no Stripe” decision). $29 sits just above the $24.99 / 400-credit pack, so “unlock the board” is the step-up without killing the $4.99 impulse top-up.

Refund of Full Access → `plan=free` unless the user is admin or `grandfathered`. Purchased credits stay. Unpaid / underpaid / expired invoices leave the user on Free.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  panel[Panel_or_pricing] --> checkout[POST_checkout]
  checkout --> invoice[NOWPayments_invoice]
  invoice --> ipn[POST_ipn]
  ipn -->|credits SKU| wallet[grant_order_credits]
  ipn -->|full_access SKU| plan[set_plan_full]
  plan --> rematch[refresh_user_opportunities]
```

## Production blockers to fix first

These will reject real IPNs or never create invoices even after keys are in `.env`:

1. **EC2 does not pass payment secrets.** [`scripts/ec2_app_deploy.sh`](scripts/ec2_app_deploy.sh) never sets `NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY` / `NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET` on `relocation-panel`.
2. **Callback URL is wrong behind Caddy.** [`create_credit_checkout`](relocation_jobs/web/routes/credits.py) uses `request.url_root` (often `http://127.0.0.1:10000/`). Use `PANEL_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` (`https://kuchup.com`) for `ipn_callback_url`, `success_url`, and `cancel_url`.
3. **HMAC likely mismatches NOWPayments.** Current code uses recursive `json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True)`. Their documented algorithm is top-level key sort (`JSON.stringify(params, Object.keys(params).sort())` / PHP `ksort`) then HMAC-SHA512. Nested IPN bodies will 401. Match their algorithm and hash the parsed object, not Flask’s raw body order.
4. **No sandbox switch.** Add `NOWPAYMENTS_SANDBOX=1` → `https://api-sandbox.nowpayments.io`; production stays on `https://api.nowpayments.io`.

Also grant only `confirmed` / `finished`. `partially_paid` must not credit or upgrade.

## Full Access on the same order table

Do **not** add a second orders table. Add `kind` to `credit_orders` (`credits` default, or `full_access`), allow `credits=0` for the plan SKU.

- SKU catalog: keep credit packs in [`credits/policy.py`](relocation_jobs/credits/policy.py); add `FULL_ACCESS` (key `full_access`, 2900 cents USD) in [`payments/`](relocation_jobs/payments/).
- [`payments/service.py`](relocation_jobs/payments/service.py) becomes the single checkout/IPN orchestrator: paid `credits` → existing `grant_order_credits`; paid `full_access` → `set_plan(user_id, "full")` then the same sync rematch admin already uses (`refresh_user_opportunities` in [`opportunities/service.py`](relocation_jobs/opportunities/service.py)).
- New authenticated `POST /api/payments/checkout` `{ "sku": "starter"|"plus"|"power"|"full_access" }`. Keep `POST /api/credits/checkout` as a thin pack wrapper so the existing dialog keeps working.
- IPN stays `POST /api/payments/nowpayments/ipn` (public, signature-gated).

## Product surfaces

- [`homepage/app/pricing/page.tsx`](homepage/app/pricing/page.tsx): replace “Coming soon” with **$29 one-time**, CTA to `/panel?upgrade=1`. Rebuild homepage static export.
- [`relocation_jobs/static/js/credits.js`](relocation_jobs/static/js/credits.js) + [`board-scope.js`](relocation_jobs/static/js/board-scope.js): Free users get **Unlock Full Access — $29** next to credit packs; success/cancel query params toast instead of only opening the dialog.
- Admin credit-orders table already reconciles/revokes; show `kind` so Full Access orders are visible.

## Ops (you put keys in gitignored `.env`; deploy passes them through)

New [`docs/operations/nowpayments.md`](docs/operations/nowpayments.md) (placeholders only):

- Dashboard: IPN secret + invoice API key; callback `https://kuchup.com/api/payments/nowpayments/ipn`
- Sandbox first (`NOWPAYMENTS_SANDBOX=1` locally), then production keys on EC2 `.env`
- If origin SG is Cloudflare-only, keep orange-cloud on `kuchup.com` so NOWPayments can reach IPN via CF
- Smoke: sandbox invoice → IPN → wallet/plan → Loki `credit_` / payment log lines

Update [`.env.example`](.env.example), [`docs/reference/entitlements-and-opportunities.md`](docs/reference/entitlements-and-opportunities.md) (Phase F shipped), and [`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md) with the ops link.

## Tests (one run after the unit of work)

`pytest tests -o addopts= -q --tb=line` covering:

- HMAC accepts NOWPayments-style top-level sorted payload; rejects bad sig
- Amount/currency mismatch does not grant
- Credit IPN grants once; replay is a no-op
- Full Access IPN sets `plan=full` and rematch is invoked; second IPN does not error
- Refund of Full Access returns `free`; grandfathered/admin not downgraded
- Checkout builds URLs from `PANEL_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` (httpx mocked)

No live NOWPayments calls in CI.

## Out of scope

- Stripe / subscriptions / email receipts
- Metering PDF/MCP as credits
- Changing Free caps or pack prices

# NOWPayments checkout (kuchup.com)

**Provider:** NOWPayments invoices + signed IPN  
**Panel callback:** `https://kuchup.com/api/payments/nowpayments/ipn`  
**Secrets:** gitignored `.env` only — never commit API keys or IPN secrets

Checkout sells credit packs (50/$4.99, 150/$11.99, 400/$24.99) and one-time **Full Access ($29)**. Credits and plan changes apply only after a verified paid IPN (`confirmed` or `finished`). Browser `success_url` / `cancel_url` redirects never mutate a wallet or plan.

---

## Environment

| Variable | Role |
|----------|------|
| `NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY` | Invoice API key from the NOWPayments dashboard |
| `NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET` | HMAC-SHA512 secret for IPN signatures |
| `NOWPAYMENTS_SANDBOX` | `1` uses `https://api-sandbox.nowpayments.io`; unset in production |
| `PANEL_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | Must be `https://kuchup.com` so invoice callbacks are not `http://127.0.0.1` |

`./scripts/ec2_app_deploy.sh deploy` copies these from local `.env` onto the panel container.

---

## Dashboard

1. Generate an IPN secret under Payment Settings and save it as `NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET`.
2. Create an API key and save it as `NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY`.
3. Invoice create already sets `ipn_callback_url` to `https://kuchup.com/api/payments/nowpayments/ipn`.
4. Sandbox first: set `NOWPAYMENTS_SANDBOX=1` locally, pay a test invoice, confirm the panel log line `payment_event paid=True`.
5. Production: unset sandbox, put live keys in `.env`, deploy.

If the origin security group is Cloudflare-only, keep the orange cloud on `kuchup.com` so NOWPayments can reach IPN through Cloudflare.

---

## Smoke

1. Sign in as a Free Google user.
2. Open Credits → starter pack or Unlock Full Access.
3. Complete sandbox payment.
4. Confirm wallet credits or `plan=full` on `GET /api/auth/status`.
5. Loki: `{job="docker"} |= "checkout_started"` or `payment_event`.
6. Admin: `GET /api/admin/credits/audit` should stay healthy. Reconcile with `POST /api/admin/credit-orders/<id>/reconcile` if a paid order missed a grant.

Refunds via the provider set the order to `refunded`, revoke unused purchased credits, and return Full Access to `free` unless the user is admin or `grandfathered`.

import hashlib
import hmac
import json

import httpx
import pytest

from relocation_jobs.payments import nowpayments
from relocation_jobs.payments.nowpayments import canonical_ipn_body, parse_notification


def _sign(payload: dict, secret: str = "secret") -> str:
    return hmac.new(secret.encode(), canonical_ipn_body(payload), hashlib.sha512).hexdigest()


def test_canonical_ipn_sorts_top_level_only():
    payload = {
        "z": 1,
        "a": {"z": 1, "a": 2},
        "invoice_id": "inv-1",
        "payment_status": "finished",
    }
    top_level = canonical_ipn_body(payload)
    recursive = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode()
    assert top_level != recursive
    assert top_level == (
        b'{"a":{"z":1,"a":2},"invoice_id":"inv-1","payment_status":"finished","z":1}'
    )


def test_parse_notification_accepts_provider_signature(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET", "secret")
    payload = {
        "z": 1,
        "a": {"z": 1, "a": 2},
        "invoice_id": "inv-1",
        "payment_status": "finished",
    }
    parsed = parse_notification(payload, _sign(payload))
    assert parsed.provider_order_id == "inv-1"
    assert parsed.status == "finished"


def test_parse_notification_rejects_recursive_sort_signature(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET", "secret")
    payload = {
        "z": 1,
        "a": {"z": 1, "a": 2},
        "invoice_id": "inv-1",
        "payment_status": "finished",
    }
    recursive = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode()
    bad = hmac.new(b"secret", recursive, hashlib.sha512).hexdigest()
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        parse_notification(payload, bad)

Payment checkout is wired end to end. Credit packs and **$29 one-time Full Access** both go through NOWPayments; the wallet and plan only change after a signed paid IPN.

**What shipped**
- HMAC matches NOWPayments (top-level key sort). Invoice URLs use `PANEL_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` (`https://kuchup.com`), not `http://127.0.0.1`.
- Sandbox switch: `NOWPAYMENTS_SANDBOX=1` hits `api-sandbox.nowpayments.io`.
- `POST /api/payments/checkout` for any SKU; pack checkout stays at `POST /api/credits/checkout`. Paid Full Access sets `plan=full` and rematches the board. Refunds return Free unless the user is admin or grandfathered.
- Pricing page, board strip, and credits dialog all offer Unlock Full Access. Deploy passes `NOWPAYMENTS_*` into the panel container.
- Ops: [docs/operations/nowpayments.md](docs/operations/nowpayments.md).

**To take money:** put `NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY` and `NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET` in gitignored `.env`. Smoke sandbox locally, then `./scripts/ec2_app_deploy.sh deploy`. Keep orange-cloud on kuchup.com if the origin SG is Cloudflare-only, so IPN can reach `https://kuchup.com/api/payments/nowpayments/ipn`.

        raise RuntimeError("Credit checkout is not configured")
    payload = {

        "price_currency": currency.lower(),
        "order_id": str(order_id),
        "order_description": description,
        "ipn_callback_url": f"{origin}/api/payments/nowpayments/ipn",
        "success_url": f"{origin}/panel?{return_query}=success",
        "cancel_url": f"{origin}/panel?{return_query}=cancelled",
    }
    response = httpx.post(
        f"{api_root()}/v1/invoice",
        headers={"x-api-key": api_key, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json=payload,
        timeout=20,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    body = response.json()
    provider_id = str(body.get("id") or body.get("invoice_id") or "").strip()
    checkout_url = str(body.get("invoice_url") or "").strip()
    if not provider_id or not checkout_url:
        raise RuntimeError("Payment provider returned an incomplete checkout")
    return CheckoutSession(provider_order_id=provider_id, checkout_url=checkout_url)
